title: Getting started
summary: Choose a learning path and follow a walkthrough without changing operational records.

steps.title: Find a page
steps.instruction: Search by page, tab, or task. Filter by workspace or topic to narrow the lesson list.

steps.title: Follow the walkthrough
steps.instruction: Read the steps in order. Open the page in a separate tab when you are ready; your normal account permissions and subscription still apply.

steps.title: Track your learning
steps.instruction: Mark a lesson complete after reviewing its steps. Progress is saved on this device for your signed-in account. Completion is a learning aid, not a compliance approval.

steps.title: Get help
steps.instruction: For a platform issue, use Help → Tech Support. Include the page, steps, expected result, and error message, without passwords or sensitive tenant details.

title: Sign in, signup & password recovery
summary: Create or recover your account and understand session expiry.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.instruction: Choose signup, enter your account details, open the Terms & Agreements, and check the required agreement only after reading it. Complete any email verification requested.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.instruction: Use your registered email and password. Complete any required verification. Your session lasts up to seven days from login; refreshing a page does not restart that period.

steps.title: Recover access
steps.instruction: Choose Forgot password, request a reset email, and use its link to enter and confirm a new password. Request a fresh link if it has expired.

steps.title: Leave a shared device
steps.instruction: Use Sign out when finished. Do not share passwords, verification codes, or recovery codes with Tech Support.

title: Free trial
summary: Use the three-review trial and its working Income Calculator.

steps.title: Start the trial
steps.instruction: Create an account or sign in from the trial entry screen. Review and accept the signup agreement when creating an account.

steps.title: Review selected certifications
steps.instruction: Upload a permitted certification and explicitly select it for review. Check the remaining free-review allowance before running reviews.

steps.title: Use the calculator
steps.instruction: Open Income Calculator while free reviews remain. Calculating does not itself consume a certification review. Working trial calculations can be printed; saving portfolio calculator records requires a subscription.

steps.title: After three reviews
steps.instruction: Once all three free reviews are used, trial calculator access ends. Review subscription options or contact Tech Support if the allowance appears incorrect.

title: Organization & Programs
summary: Configure the organization, jurisdictions, and actual program layers.

steps.title: Organization profile
steps.instruction: Enter the organization name, type, contact information, and states where it operates.

steps.title: Program selection
steps.instruction: Select every operated program. Use the actual property or agency funding documents; do not add a program merely to expose another screen.

steps.title: PHA configuration
steps.instruction: For a PHA, confirm program operations, agency cohort, and reporting path against the agency's applicable source records.

steps.title: Save and verify
steps.instruction: Save the profile, confirm the saved values, then return to Onboarding & Portfolio Setup. HOTMA applicability is derived from the program configuration.

title: Onboarding & Portfolio Setup
summary: Complete the six saved setup steps.

steps.title: 1 · Welcome to CertivoIQ
steps.instruction: Start the setup checklist. Each later checkpoint checks saved records.

steps.title: 2 · Confirm organization profile
steps.instruction: Open Organization & Programs, save the required profile, return, and select Verify saved profile & continue.

steps.title: 3 · Complete portfolio & tenant onboarding
steps.instruction: Import properties, units, and tenant profiles through portfolio onboarding. Return and verify; at least one saved property, unit, and tenant profile is required.

steps.title: 4 · Upload first certification
steps.instruction: Open Upload Certification & OCR and complete a certification upload. Portfolio CSV onboarding does not satisfy this checkpoint.

steps.title: 5 · Set team access
steps.instruction: Review account security and grant only the access each team member needs through the appropriate administrator controls.

steps.title: 6 · Confirm operational readiness
steps.instruction: Review the saved setup and support path, then complete onboarding. This confirms setup, not compliance approval.

title: Portfolio & tenant onboarding
summary: Match varying CSV headers and import property, unit, and tenant records.

steps.title: Choose your file
steps.instruction: Choose a portfolio and tenant CSV/TSV. The template is optional; use your own headers and map equivalent fields.

steps.title: Match fields & preview
steps.instruction: Check each source column, destination field, and sample value. Map property identifiers consistently so units and tenants attach to the correct property.

steps.title: Resolve dates and state
steps.instruction: Choose the actual date format and supply an actual property state when required. Fix preview errors; never infer missing resident information.

steps.title: Confirm import
steps.instruction: Review the preview and explicit confirmation before importing. Inspect the resulting counts and return to the setup checklist. Certification documents belong in Upload Certification & OCR.

title: Dashboard / Command Center
summary: Read the workspace overview and open the source queue behind each item.

steps.title: Confirm workspace
steps.instruction: Check the workspace and active program profile. Available navigation depends on your role and organization.

steps.title: Portfolio operations
steps.instruction: Review certifications awaiting review, Needs Your Attention, due dates, and upcoming compliance work. Open the underlying task or certification to act.

steps.title: Portfolio status & audit readiness
steps.instruction: Use summaries to prioritize work, then inspect the source records and outstanding evidence before treating an item as complete.

steps.title: PHA queues
steps.instruction: For a PHA, review families, HUD-50058, inspections, accommodations, portability, and waiting-list queues appropriate to your role.

steps.title: Program configuration
steps.instruction: Check program configuration and HOTMA readiness when applicable. Demonstration workspace figures are examples, not your live portfolio.

title: Upload Certification & OCR
summary: Review the original source and extracted certification before saving.

steps.title: Select a packet
steps.instruction: Upload PDF, PNG, JPEG, or WEBP certification documents within the displayed size and page limits. Use portfolio onboarding for tenant CSV files.

steps.title: Choose destination
steps.instruction: Select the existing tenant file when saving to the portfolio. Confirm the property, unit, and household before continuing.

steps.title: Review source and form
steps.instruction: Compare the original TIC source preview with the editable CertivoIQ TIC Review Form. Correct extraction errors using the source; leave unresolved values for review.

steps.title: Classify supporting pages
steps.instruction: Review supporting-document classifications and original pages. Use Part of TIC — do not create supporting record for pages that belong to the certification itself.

steps.title: Save or cancel
steps.instruction: Save only after checking the packet and destination. Cancel Upload abandons the staged upload. Starting a compliance review is a separate explicit action in the review queue.

title: TIC Review Form · Parts I–IX
summary: Walk through every part of the editable TIC review form.

steps.title: Certification heading
steps.instruction: Confirm Initial Certification, Recertification, or Other and the effective date from the original source.

steps.title: Part I · Development Data
steps.instruction: Check property, building, unit, and program identifiers against the uploaded form.

steps.title: Part II · Household Composition
steps.instruction: Review each member and the applicable household fields. Preserve source values rather than guessing missing details.

steps.title: Part III · Gross Annual Income
steps.instruction: Check annual wages, Social Security, public assistance, and other income for each member against supporting sources.

steps.title: Part IV · Assets
steps.instruction: Review the applicable IVA or IVB asset section and its threshold context. Check asset amounts and actual or imputed income against the source.

steps.title: Part V · Total Household Income
steps.instruction: Reconcile the income and asset-income totals with their supporting rows.

steps.title: Household certification
steps.instruction: Inspect the household certification and source signatures. An extracted signature field is not permission to sign for someone else.

steps.title: Part VI · Income Eligibility
steps.instruction: Check household size, applicable income limit, and eligibility fields against the correct program and effective date.

steps.title: Part VII · Rent
steps.instruction: Review rent, utility allowance, subsidy, and related rent-limit fields using the applicable sources.

steps.title: Part VIII · Student Status
steps.instruction: Review the student-status selections and any required supporting evidence.

steps.title: Part IX · Program Type
steps.instruction: Confirm all applicable program selections. Check the owner/representative signature area before saving the reviewed form.

title: Certification Review Queue
summary: Select exactly which uploaded certifications to review and inspect their evidence.

steps.title: Find uploaded records
steps.instruction: Locate the certification in the queue. An uploaded or extracted file has not automatically received a completed compliance review.

steps.title: Set review context
steps.instruction: Confirm Initial, Annual, or Interim certification type and the applicable jurisdiction.

steps.title: Select and review
steps.instruction: Check only the intended records and choose Review selected. During a trial, verify the remaining allowance first.

steps.title: Inspect evidence and results
steps.instruction: Open the selected certification's evidence and findings. Compare extracted values to source pages; ambiguous or missing evidence must remain unresolved.

steps.title: Correct and re-review
steps.instruction: Attach the appropriate supporting evidence and resolve the documented issue. Re-review through the controlled workflow; use Tasks for required follow-up.

title: Certification detail demonstration
summary: Understand the legacy file-detail tabs using sample records.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.instruction: The legacy file-detail page uses the demonstration dataset. Open an available sample from its linked demonstration view; use the live Certification Review Queue for customer work.

steps.title: Calculation tab
steps.instruction: Inspect how income calculations and source references are presented in the example.

steps.title: Extraction tab
steps.instruction: Compare sample extracted fields and source provenance. Do not copy sample values into a real household.

steps.title: Findings tab
steps.instruction: Read each example finding and cited rule. Validate the applicable current source in the live workflow.

steps.title: Timeline tab
steps.instruction: Review the sample sequence of upload, review, and follow-up events. The sample timeline is not your account history.

title: Income Calculator · all tabs
summary: Build a supported calculation for each applicable program layer.

steps.title: Household
steps.instruction: For a subscribed portfolio, select property, unit, and household. During a trial, choose the working program layers. Confirm certification type, date, household size, assistance, composition, and expected changes.

steps.title: Jobs & Pay
steps.instruction: Choose the documented basis: hourly rate and hours, pay-period gross and frequency, or comparable paystub average. Enter overtime with its actual rate and hours. Do not count alternate bases for the same job twice.

steps.title: Other Income & Assets
steps.instruction: Add separate supported income and asset rows. Do not enter wages again as other income. Review evidence and any applicable exclusions.

steps.title: Prior 12 Months
steps.instruction: Use the required historical coverage only when applicable to the program method. A three-month sample does not replace a required twelve-month history.

steps.title: Program Adjustments
steps.instruction: Review exclusions, deductions, adjusted income, or accepted determinations separately for each program layer, including dates and evidence. Do not transfer one program's deductions to another.

steps.title: Property Rule Setup / Program Rule Inputs
steps.instruction: Confirm authority, policy, effective dates, income limits, household tiers, and rounding from documented sources. Paid rule profiles require the controlled signature flow. Trial inputs are working inputs with a review checkbox.

steps.title: Results & Review
steps.instruction: Inspect annual income, the applicable limit, difference, and each program's result. Resolve Not determined items before final review. Paid snapshots are recomputed when saved; record the responsible party's name, position, and signature when required. Print only for the intended audience.

title: Tasks
summary: Complete operational follow-up through its source record.

steps.title: Choose a queue
steps.instruction: Review active tasks, awaiting approval, verification required, and exceptions. Prioritize due dates and unresolved evidence.

steps.title: Open the source
steps.instruction: Open the linked certification, finding, validation, or filing. Read the reason and required action before changing anything.

steps.title: Complete the action
steps.instruction: Attach or correct supported evidence and use the available resolution or approval action. Required source validation and final-review controls still apply.

steps.title: Verify the result
steps.instruction: Return to Tasks and confirm the status changed. If it stays blocked, inspect the remaining prerequisite and report a reproducible issue to Tech Support.

title: Audit Operations
summary: Create a preparation checklist, resolve findings, and record final review.

steps.title: Start a preparation run
steps.instruction: Choose organization, portfolio, or property scope, jurisdiction, and framework. Create the readiness checklist for that scope.

steps.title: Review the checklist
steps.instruction: Inspect program inventory, restrictions, limits, reports, occupancy, leases, inspections, TICs, verifications, hashes, findings, and notices as applicable.

steps.title: Resolve corrective actions
steps.instruction: Open the source records for missing evidence or findings. Unresolved requirements block completion; a checklist does not replace the underlying evidence.

steps.title: Pending final review
steps.instruction: When prerequisites clear, the responsible party reviews the package and records their name, position, and signature. Confirm the correct scope before signing.

steps.title: Export & history
steps.instruction: Export the permitted evidence package and check the signed confirmation. Preparation history retains snapshots; preserve the locked final-review record.

title: Document Intelligence
summary: Read recognition, source, and document-version controls.

steps.title: Browse the registry
steps.instruction: Find the document type and review required fields, signatures, program applicability, and effective dates.

steps.title: Filter support status
steps.instruction: Distinguish supported recognition from needs source validation or other incomplete states.

steps.title: Inspect recent documents
steps.instruction: Open relevant certification documents and compare recognition with the actual uploaded source.

steps.title: Resolve source gaps
steps.instruction: Route missing or ambiguous source evidence through validation. Recognition alone is not a compliance determination.

title: Program Compliance / Federal & Source Rules
summary: Inspect applicable rule layers and source versions.

steps.title: Choose the layer
steps.instruction: Review federal, state, local, agency, and property requirements relevant to the selected programs.

steps.title: Inspect source provenance
steps.instruction: Check issuing authority, version, effective date, and validation status rather than relying on a title alone.

steps.title: Review state registry
steps.instruction: Open the jurisdiction's available source information. Missing or unvalidated sources cannot be treated as released rules.

steps.title: Preserve history
steps.instruction: Use the version applicable to the certification date. Superseded versions remain evidence for historical work.

title: State Rule Validation
summary: Capture exact official source bytes and complete independent validation.

steps.title: Select state & status
steps.instruction: Use the state and status filters to inspect queued, captured, verified, blocked, rejected, or historical records.

steps.title: Capture exact evidence
steps.instruction: Identify the exact official document, issuing authority, program, document type, source URL, retrieval date, and effective date. Record the exact file's SHA-256.

steps.title: Review applicability
steps.instruction: Check content against the checklist requirement, completeness, and supersession history. A matching title or landing page is insufficient.

steps.title: Independent validation
steps.instruction: Use the required independent administrator review; do not approve your own evidence as the second reviewer. Shared federal evidence retains its own validation controls.

steps.title: Verify release status
steps.instruction: Confirm every release prerequisite is satisfied before activation. Blocked source records remain pending until their specific issue is resolved.

title: Submission Center
summary: Prepare a controlled filing and distinguish preparation from external delivery.

steps.title: Choose eligible work
steps.instruction: Select a live certification and validated destination. Check that rule authority and submission authorization are allowed.

steps.title: Confirm reporting context
steps.instruction: Verify property identifier and name, program, reporting period, and required destination details.

steps.title: Prepare the manifest
steps.instruction: Review the draft manifest and evidence. Resolve all blockers before requesting submission.

steps.title: Authorize & verify delivery
steps.instruction: External delivery requires its separate authorization. Check the submission result and receipt; a prepared draft is not proof of delivery.

title: HOTMA Readiness
summary: Review applicability and source-backed readiness for your workspace.

steps.title: Confirm program context
steps.instruction: Read the workspace's applicable HOTMA overlays. Do not choose readiness from a calendar date alone.

steps.title: Review readiness controls
steps.instruction: Check source validation, policy, evidence, calculation, and system/reporting prerequisites shown on the page.

steps.title: PHA cohort & reporting
steps.instruction: For PHA work, inspect the applicable cohort, program control matrix, reporting path, and blocked families or HUD-50058 items.

steps.title: Resolve exceptions
steps.instruction: Open the linked policy or evidence gap. Authorized staff maintain authoritative controls; agency preferences cannot override them.

title: Users & Account Security
summary: Protect your account and understand session handling.

steps.title: Review security
steps.instruction: Open Users & Security or Account Security from Administration. Review the available authentication controls.

steps.title: Enroll MFA
steps.instruction: Follow the on-screen authenticator enrollment, then enter the current code to confirm. Keep the enrollment secret private.

steps.title: Keep recovery codes safe
steps.instruction: Save recovery codes somewhere secure outside Tech Support messages. Use the appropriate administrator invitation page to manage other users.

steps.title: End a session
steps.instruction: Sign out on shared devices. The login session expires after seven days even when tokens refresh; sign in again when prompted.

title: Billing & checkout return
summary: Review authorized subscription and invoice information.

steps.title: Confirm authority
steps.instruction: Billing controls are limited by account and role. Have the authorized organization contact handle procurement and payment actions.

steps.title: Review scope
steps.instruction: Inspect the subscription, licensed scope, invoice information, and signed commercial terms. Pay attention to any test-environment banner.

steps.title: Complete authorized payment
steps.instruction: Follow the displayed invoice or checkout flow only for an approved purchase.

steps.title: Check the return state
steps.instruction: After checkout returns, verify the recorded billing status. A browser redirect by itself does not establish a completed payment; contact Tech Support for a discrepancy.

title: Tech Support
summary: Report a platform issue with enough detail for investigation.

steps.title: Describe the issue
steps.instruction: Enter your contact details and a specific subject identifying the affected page.

steps.title: Provide reproducible steps
steps.instruction: Describe what you selected, what you expected, what happened, and the error text. Include the approximate time and browser when helpful.

steps.title: Protect sensitive information
steps.instruction: Do not include passwords, verification codes, recovery codes, full payment details, or unnecessary tenant information.

steps.title: Submit & retain confirmation
steps.instruction: Submit the case and retain its confirmation or case number. CertivoIQ remains in Beta Testing until July 11, 2027; report platform issues here.

title: SupportIQ
summary: Find routine product guidance and escalate account-specific issues.

steps.title: Ask a product question
steps.instruction: Describe the screen or workflow you need help using without including sensitive resident information.

steps.title: Review the guidance
steps.instruction: Compare instructions with the current page and your permissions. Product guidance does not approve a compliance determination.

steps.title: Escalate when needed
steps.instruction: Use Help → Tech Support for access failures, security concerns, billing disputes, or a reproducible platform issue. Retain the case reference.

title: Suggest a Feature
summary: Submit a workflow idea and follow its review status.

steps.title: Choose category & importance
steps.instruction: Choose feature, workflow, integration, reporting, accessibility, or another relevant category.

steps.title: Explain the outcome
steps.instruction: Enter a clear title, current problem, proposed behavior, affected page, and expected improvement. Your account and role context are attached.

steps.title: Submit & track
steps.instruction: Send the suggestion and review Your recent suggestions for its status. A submitted idea is not a delivery commitment.

steps.title: Use support for issues
steps.instruction: For a broken workflow or urgent access problem, submit a Tech Support case instead.

title: Family Intake & Evidence
summary: Create a family action and establish its evidence.

steps.title: Create a family action
steps.instruction: Choose the actual program and action, such as admission, annual, interim, or portability. Confirm the effective date and family identity.

steps.title: Collect evidence
steps.instruction: Record household and verification information from the supporting documents. Review applicable EIV evidence and dates.

steps.title: Resolve conflicts
steps.instruction: Inspect conflicting or missing evidence and document its resolution. Do not release a determination with unresolved required evidence.

steps.title: Continue to reexamination
steps.instruction: Open the saved action in Families & Reexaminations and verify the evidence is attached to the intended family.

title: Families & Reexaminations
summary: Review family actions and program-specific determinations.

steps.title: Select the family action
steps.instruction: Find the correct family, program, action type, and effective date in the queue.

steps.title: Determination workbench
steps.instruction: Review annual income, applicable deductions, minimum rent, utility allowance, payment standard, gross rent, and rent to owner as appropriate for the program.

steps.title: Program-specific controls
steps.instruction: Review applicable flat-rent choices, mixed-family proration, and other controls using validated policy and evidence. Do not substitute another program's method.

steps.title: Save & follow prerequisites
steps.instruction: Save the validated determination, resolve notice prerequisites, and inspect the related HUD-50058 queue status.

title: HCV Portability
summary: Track portability coordination and supporting evidence.

steps.title: Start the linked action
steps.instruction: Create or select the HCV portability family action before adding the portability record.

steps.title: Coordinate the port
steps.instruction: Confirm initial and receiving PHA information, direction, dates, and required coordination evidence.

steps.title: Review HUD-52665 evidence
steps.instruction: Attach and check the required portability documentation and applicable billing or absorption decision.

steps.title: Track the register
steps.instruction: Review open actions, follow-up, and audit history. Recording a coordination step does not confirm an external PHA completed it.

title: HCV Lease-Up
summary: Move from voucher issuance to an evidence-supported HAP contract.

steps.title: Voucher issuance
steps.instruction: Select the correct family action and record the voucher details and supporting evidence.

steps.title: RFTA & tenancy approval
steps.instruction: Review the request for tenancy approval, unit, rent, inspection prerequisites, and required supporting records.

steps.title: HAP contract
steps.instruction: Check contract execution details and dates only after the required controls clear.

steps.title: Payment blockers
steps.instruction: Review payment-related holds and resolve their source evidence. Do not treat a saved lease-up record as payment authorization.

title: PBV Operations
summary: Maintain project-based voucher contract and family controls.

steps.title: Contract register
steps.instruction: Select the correct PBV project and HAP contract. Review the term and source evidence.

steps.title: Contract & rent actions
steps.instruction: Review documented contract changes and rent-to-owner actions with their effective dates and supporting authority.

steps.title: Family right to move
steps.instruction: Track the family's applicable right-to-move request and linked action without treating it as automatic approval.

steps.title: Current work
steps.instruction: Review pending controls and resolve missing evidence before advancing the action.

title: PBV Waiting Lists
summary: Manage PBV list structure, referrals, and eligibility controls.

steps.title: Select list structure
steps.instruction: Confirm central, shared, project-specific, or approved owner-maintained list arrangements against validated policy.

steps.title: Review applicants
steps.instruction: Check applicant records, verified preferences, and the intended project or list.

steps.title: Manage referrals
steps.instruction: Record the referral and review PHA eligibility prerequisites before an owner offer.

steps.title: Inspect history & holds
steps.instruction: Review selection history and unresolved accommodation or eligibility holds before moving forward.

title: Public Housing Operations
summary: Track rent elections and over-income actions.

steps.title: Select the household action
steps.instruction: Confirm the Public Housing family, effective date, and current determination.

steps.title: Rent election
steps.instruction: Review the supported rent choice and applicable evidence under the validated policy.

steps.title: Over-income monitoring
steps.instruction: Inspect monitoring records, notices, and required follow-up. Use the dates and controls shown for the actual case.

steps.title: Controlled next steps
steps.instruction: Review alternative-rent lease or termination prerequisites as applicable. Do not bypass a required notice or review.

title: Public Housing Admissions
summary: Review development admission controls before offering a unit.

steps.title: Development admission profile
steps.instruction: Confirm the development, applicable designation, accessibility information, and policy sources.

steps.title: Targeting & deconcentration
steps.instruction: Review fiscal-year targeting and deconcentration controls applicable to the admission.

steps.title: Applicant eligibility
steps.instruction: Check verified evidence and unresolved holds linked to the applicant.

steps.title: Final unit offer
steps.instruction: Advance an offer only after the required controls clear. Waiting-list rank alone does not establish admission approval.

title: Public Housing Occupancy
summary: Record leases, transfers, and occupancy controls.

steps.title: Lease record
steps.instruction: Select the household and unit; review the applicable lease, evidence, and signature requirements.

steps.title: Execute supported changes
steps.instruction: Record execution details and effective dates only when the required records are available.

steps.title: Transfers
steps.instruction: Link the destination unit and any related accommodation, notice, or grievance records.

steps.title: Inspect holds
steps.instruction: Resolve occupancy holds through the underlying workflow and retain the history.

title: Mod Rehab Operations
summary: Use the separate Mod Rehab contract and HAP workflow.

steps.title: Contract register
steps.instruction: Select the correct Mod Rehab contract and inspect its program and source evidence.

steps.title: HAP actions
steps.instruction: Review the requested action, effective dates, family context, and required supporting records.

steps.title: Rent adjustment or abatement
steps.instruction: Check applicable validated sources and evidence before recording an adjustment or abatement.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.instruction: Review pending work and history. Do not reuse HCV or PBV assumptions for a Mod Rehab determination.

title: Waiting Lists
summary: Manage HCV and Public Housing lists under validated policies.

steps.title: Choose program & list
steps.instruction: Select the intended HCV or Public Housing list and confirm the applicable Administrative Plan or ACOP.

steps.title: Preference definitions
steps.instruction: Use controlled preferences supported by the active policy. Review evidence for each applicant's claimed preference.

steps.title: Selection
steps.instruction: Review eligibility, ranking, and required controls before recording a selection.

steps.title: History & accommodations
steps.instruction: Inspect selection history and accommodation holds. Resolve open required reviews before any removal.

title: HUD-50058 Queue
summary: Review reporting readiness, attempts, and actual responses.

steps.title: Inspect routing readiness
steps.instruction: Select the family action and confirm program, cohort, reporting path, and required determination and notice prerequisites.

steps.title: Submission controls
steps.instruction: Review release blockers and the prepared payload before an authorized submission attempt.

steps.title: Attempt history
steps.instruction: Inspect the saved payload snapshot and external response for each attempt. An attempt is not an acceptance.

steps.title: Corrections & resubmission
steps.instruction: Resolve reported errors, document the correction, and use the controlled resubmission action. Verify the resulting response.

title: NSPIRE Inspections
summary: Schedule and document inspections using the assigned standards.

steps.title: Schedule inspection
steps.instruction: Choose the correct property or unit and record the inspection context and date.

steps.title: Check standards profile
steps.instruction: Review the system-assigned standards and transition profile. A reinspection retains the required original standard context.

steps.title: Findings & corrections
steps.instruction: Record observed findings and the required corrective evidence. Use the applicable displayed deadlines and program controls.

steps.title: Verify closure
steps.instruction: Review correction evidence and outstanding holds before closing the inspection.

title: NSPIRE Standards Control
summary: Inspect official standards evidence and activation gates.

steps.title: Official bundle
steps.instruction: Review the source bundle, document counts, hashes, and applicable standards version.

steps.title: Deficiency records
steps.instruction: Check that required deficiencies and program-specific timing controls are populated and source-backed.

steps.title: Independent attestations
steps.instruction: Authorized validators record the required two distinct attestations. Do not substitute duplicate or self-approved reviews.

steps.title: Activation status
steps.instruction: Confirm every prerequisite before activation. Missing evidence keeps the standards control blocked.

title: Reasonable Accommodations
summary: Track requests and their linked workflow holds.

steps.title: Create or select a request
steps.instruction: Identify the affected workflow and record only the information required for the accommodation review.

steps.title: Link affected work
steps.instruction: Link applications, waiting lists, inspections, reexaminations, hearings, or communications as applicable.

steps.title: Review & communicate
steps.instruction: Record the supported decision and effective-communication requirements through the authorized process.

steps.title: Verify holds
steps.instruction: Check that linked controls reflect the decision. An open required review prevents waiting-list removal.

title: Family Notices
summary: Prepare and issue notices after determination and source checks.

steps.title: Determination queue
steps.instruction: Select the correct family action and verify the saved determination.

steps.title: Template & authority
steps.instruction: Check the active policy, legal source, required notice template, and effective version.

steps.title: Preview
steps.instruction: Review recipient details, dates, content, and evidence. Previewing is not issuing or delivering a notice.

steps.title: Issue & verify
steps.instruction: Use the authorized issuance action, retain its record, and check whether related HUD-50058 prerequisites have cleared.

title: Policies & Notice Controls
summary: Maintain agency policy versions and dependent notice controls.

steps.title: Choose policy type
steps.instruction: Select Administrative Plan, ACOP, or Mod Rehab policy as applicable to the program.

steps.title: Record version & source
steps.instruction: Review the source, effective dates, version, and supporting evidence.

steps.title: Validate explicitly
steps.instruction: Complete required validation before treating the policy as active.

steps.title: Supersession & notices
steps.instruction: Confirm the new active version and retained history. Missing active policy or legal sources can block family notices.

title: Source Library
summary: Review controlled agency and federal source records.

steps.title: Find a source
steps.instruction: Search or browse the relevant program and document type.

steps.title: Check scope
steps.instruction: Distinguish agency/workspace sources from authoritative federal controls managed by authorized staff.

steps.title: Inspect evidence
steps.instruction: Check exact source, effective date, version, hash, and validation status where shown.

steps.title: Template dependencies
steps.instruction: Verify that notice templates use current validated sources and active policy before relying on them.

title: Reports & Evidence
summary: Inspect and export the permitted family evidence manifest.

steps.title: Choose scope
steps.instruction: Select the intended family action or reporting scope available to your role.

steps.title: Review the manifest
steps.instruction: Inspect actions, evidence, calculations, notices, HUD-50058 records, and rule references.

steps.title: Resolve integrity flags
steps.instruction: Open missing or inconsistent source records and correct the underlying issue.

steps.title: Export responsibly
steps.instruction: Export only the authorized scope and share through your approved organization process.

title: Settings & Integrations
summary: Review agency defaults and actual integration readiness.

steps.title: Operational defaults
steps.instruction: Confirm the agency's configured defaults and program context.

steps.title: Escalations
steps.instruction: Review assigned responsibilities and escalation settings so blocked work reaches the appropriate role.

steps.title: Integration registry
steps.instruction: Inspect each integration's status and required validation. Pending setup does not mean connected.

steps.title: Verify saved settings
steps.instruction: Save authorized changes and confirm their recorded values; use Tech Support for a connection issue.

title: Users & Permissions
summary: Invite and maintain agency access with the appropriate authority.

steps.title: Confirm administrator access
steps.instruction: Agency owners and authorized administrators manage users. Choose the minimum role required for the work.

steps.title: Prepare an invitation
steps.instruction: Check the recipient email, agency context, and role before sending an actual invitation.

steps.title: Track invitation state
steps.instruction: Distinguish sent, delivered, accepted, expired, and revoked states. Invitations expire after seven days.

steps.title: Maintain access
steps.instruction: Review active users and deactivate access when required. Historical work remains part of the audit record.

title: CRM Pipeline
summary: Manage verified account opportunities and follow-up.

steps.title: Pipeline
steps.instruction: Review stages and opportunity context; use verified account information rather than assuming a lead is qualified.

steps.title: Accounts & contacts
steps.instruction: Open the account detail to check ownership, contact source, and relevant decision-maker role.

steps.title: Activity & materials
steps.instruction: Review timeline, follow-up, and approved materials. Sending outreach is a separate deliberate action requiring authorization.

title: CRM Account Details
summary: Review an account's evidence, contacts, and activity.

steps.title: Open an account
steps.instruction: Choose the actual account from Pipeline to open its detail page.

steps.title: Account facts & contacts
steps.instruction: Verify organization, ownership or management, decision-maker role, and contact source before updating records.

steps.title: Opportunity & timeline
steps.instruction: Review opportunity details and logged activity. Record supported changes and planned follow-up without inventing contact outcomes.

title: CRM Billing
summary: Review enterprise billing under staff permissions.

steps.title: Choose the account
steps.instruction: Confirm the customer and contract scope before opening billing records.

steps.title: Invoices & status
steps.instruction: Review the recorded invoice, entitlement, and payment state. Follow the signed commercial terms.

steps.title: Authorized actions
steps.instruction: Use only billing actions permitted to your role and approved for the customer. Verify the resulting status.

title: CRM Documents
summary: Find and maintain approved staff materials.

steps.title: Choose a category
steps.instruction: Browse one-pagers, decks, case studies, brand assets, and worksheets.

steps.title: Review the document
steps.instruction: Check version, intended audience, and approval status before use.

steps.title: Handle private materials
steps.instruction: Keep internal documents within authorized staff access. Confirm a material is approved before external sharing.

title: CRM Support
summary: Triage and follow customer support cases.

steps.title: Choose the queue
steps.instruction: Review open, pending, critical, unassigned, and resolved cases.

steps.title: Read the case
steps.instruction: Inspect the issue, customer context, priority, assignee, and conversation before responding.

steps.title: Assign & follow up
steps.instruction: Use authorized controls to route work, record investigation, and follow up. Do not include unnecessary resident details in a response.

steps.title: Resolution
steps.instruction: Confirm the issue outcome and record the case status with an understandable explanation.

title: CRM Operations
summary: Supervise operational jobs, approvals, and incidents.

steps.title: Work queues
steps.instruction: Inspect pending jobs and their evidence before advancing work.

steps.title: Approvals
steps.instruction: Follow required approval authority and independent review. Do not self-approve where a separate reviewer is required.

steps.title: Incidents & quarantine
steps.instruction: Review incident details and quarantined items; resolve the documented blocker through the prescribed controls.

steps.title: Communications
steps.instruction: Review drafts and their approval state. A prepared draft is not permission to send.

title: CRM PHA Controls
summary: Maintain authoritative PHA program and reporting controls.

steps.title: Source controls
steps.instruction: Review validated program sources and effective versions.

steps.title: Cohort & reporting
steps.instruction: Inspect authoritative cohort and reporting-path controls rather than agency preferences.

steps.title: Review & activate
steps.instruction: Resolve source or review prerequisites before activating a control, retaining historical evidence.

title: Staff Access
summary: Invite and maintain internal staff or approved beta access.

steps.title: Administrator authority
steps.instruction: Only authorized administrators or managers may manage staff access.

steps.title: Prepare the invitation
steps.instruction: Choose the intended internal or beta PHA access, exact recipient, and appropriate role. Review before sending.

steps.title: Track acceptance
steps.instruction: Check delivery, acceptance, expiry, or revocation. Sent does not mean access has been accepted.

steps.title: Deactivate appropriately
steps.instruction: Remove access when needed while preserving historical activity and audit records.

title: Marketing Kit
summary: Review printable product material before approved use.

steps.title: Choose material
steps.instruction: Open the available one-page or printable product content.

steps.title: Check current claims
steps.instruction: Verify features, pricing, and availability against current approved terms before sharing.

steps.title: Print or share
steps.instruction: Use the page's print/export controls for approved purposes. Preparing a document does not send outreach.

title: Founder activation
summary: Understand the restricted one-time founder setup.

steps.title: Restricted use
steps.instruction: This flow is only for the designated founder account. Team members use ordinary invitations and sign-in.

steps.title: Verification
steps.instruction: The designated founder follows the verification and sign-in steps. Do not share credentials or verification links.

steps.title: Already activated
steps.instruction: After activation, use normal sign-in and Staff Access for administration. Do not create another founder identity.

title: Findings & Corrections
summary: Read the sample findings view.

steps.title: Inspect examples
steps.instruction: This legacy view contains demonstration findings. Use the live Certification Review Queue and Tasks for actual customer corrections.

steps.title: Review finding details
steps.instruction: Read the sample severity, rule reference, certification, and remediation context.

steps.title: Apply the workflow, not sample values
steps.instruction: For a real record, validate evidence and use its controlled resolution action. A sample finding is not a live compliance determination.

title: Property detail
summary: Understand the sample property overview.

steps.title: Open a property example
steps.instruction: The legacy property-detail screen uses demonstration records. For real imports, use Portfolio & tenant onboarding.

steps.title: Property overview
steps.instruction: Review sample risk score, program designations, overdue recertifications, and upcoming audit information.

steps.title: Certifications
steps.instruction: Inspect linked sample certifications and risk factors. Do not treat these examples as your portfolio data.

title: Portfolio Compliance
summary: Explore a sample portfolio readiness table.

steps.title: Read the table
steps.instruction: This page presents example property readiness information.

steps.title: Compare sample properties
steps.instruction: Inspect the displayed risk and readiness measures to understand the overview format.

steps.title: Use actual evidence
steps.instruction: Open Dashboard, Tasks, or Audit Operations for current account records and controlled follow-up.

title: Audit Simulator
summary: Explore a sample audit framework and findings presentation.

steps.title: Choose the framework
steps.instruction: Select the displayed federal or state framework and jurisdiction options.

steps.title: Inspect sample results
steps.instruction: The current simulator uses sample findings and a demonstration score; it does not run a live portfolio audit.

steps.title: Prepare a real audit
steps.instruction: Use Audit Operations to create a scope-specific preparation checklist and collect actual evidence.

title: Executive Demo Dashboard
summary: Explore the demonstration portfolio oversight view.

steps.title: Review sample metrics
steps.instruction: Inspect the executive overview and example portfolio information.

steps.title: Explore linked views
steps.instruction: Open the demonstration sections to understand navigation and reporting structure.

steps.title: Return to live work
steps.instruction: Use the signed-in Dashboard for your authorized operational workspace. Sample metrics are not your organization's results.

title: Compliance Assistant
summary: Explore cited explanations using the demonstration questions.

steps.title: Choose a suggested question
steps.instruction: The current walkthrough uses prepared responses for the sample portfolio.

steps.title: Inspect the answer
steps.instruction: Read the explanation and citations to understand the presentation. These sample responses are not current advice for your own household.

steps.title: Use the actual review record
steps.instruction: For customer work, inspect validated sources, evidence, and results in the Certification Review Queue. Use Tech Support for product issues.

title: PMS Integration Hub
summary: Understand the current provider setup screen.

steps.title: Choose a provider
steps.instruction: Review the listed provider and the proposed connection context.

steps.title: Begin connection setup
steps.instruction: The current setup button displays setup guidance; it does not establish a working external connection.

steps.title: Confirm readiness
steps.instruction: Use Tech Support to coordinate supported integration work. Do not assume data is syncing until a connection is explicitly validated.

title: Product overview
summary: Learn the product workflow and available starting points.

steps.title: Explore the product
steps.instruction: Review the product explanation and workflow examples.

steps.title: Choose your workspace
steps.instruction: Use the relevant Multifamily or PHA information and compare features with your intended work.

steps.title: Start or return
steps.instruction: Open the trial or sign in to your account. Demonstration scenarios are examples.

title: PHA product & role pages
summary: Explore PHA features by operational role.

steps.title: PHA overview
steps.instruction: Review the agency workflow and program coverage presented on the product page.

steps.title: Role pages
steps.instruction: Follow the available executive, compliance, HCV, Public Housing, finance, or technology role links to understand the relevant workflow.

steps.title: Operational access
steps.instruction: Use your signed-in workspace to perform actual work; product role pages do not grant permissions.

title: Pricing
summary: Review platform scope and commercial options.

steps.title: Compare offerings
steps.instruction: Review the applicable Multifamily or PHA scope and listed features.

steps.title: Review optional services
steps.instruction: Check any optional service or implementation item separately from the platform license.

steps.title: Confirm terms
steps.instruction: Review the current offer conditions and signed order terms with the authorized purchasing contact before committing.

title: Terms & Agreements
summary: Understand the agreement accepted at signup.

steps.title: Read the agreement
steps.instruction: Review service scope, account responsibilities, trial and subscription terms, and applicable limitations.

steps.title: Beta Testing
steps.instruction: CertivoIQ remains in Beta Testing until July 11, 2027. Report platform issues through Help → Tech Support.

steps.title: Security disclosure
steps.instruction: Review account protection, security limitations, session handling, and incident reporting. Never send passwords or recovery codes in a support case.

title: Privacy
summary: Understand information handling and privacy contacts.

steps.title: Read the notice
steps.instruction: Review the information described, its use, and applicable sharing and retention information.

steps.title: Review your responsibilities
steps.instruction: Use only information you are authorized to handle in the platform.

steps.title: Questions or requests
steps.instruction: Use the contact or request process stated in the current notice for privacy questions.

title: Security information
summary: Read the platform's published security information.

steps.title: Review published controls
steps.instruction: Read the current security information and its stated scope.

steps.title: Protect your account
steps.instruction: Use a unique password, available MFA, and appropriate team permissions. Sign out of shared devices.

steps.title: Report concerns
steps.instruction: Use Help → Tech Support for suspected security issues without disclosing passwords, authentication codes, or unnecessary resident data.

title: Methodology
summary: Understand how evidence and rule validation support results.

steps.title: Review the workflow
steps.instruction: Read how extraction, evidence records, source validation, and rule evaluation connect.

steps.title: Understand uncertainty
steps.instruction: Missing or ambiguous evidence must stay unresolved until supported; an extracted field is not itself a validated fact.

steps.title: Final review
steps.instruction: Use source-backed results and the required responsible-party review, position, and signature. A training completion does not authorize a determination.
